# TOPS candidate fixtures

`layouts.json` is a separate NOT-QUALIFIED profile. Restoring broad mapping root
32 and removing `lpinfo_array` reproduces the exact original historical TOPS
profile. The historical 431 and qualified 425 files remain unchanged.

`source-review.json` is generated by `prepare_tops_lpinfo`. It binds both complete
TOPS proof generations, all 35 frozen artifacts and their raw report crosslinks.
It records the six-record bound, custom primary-source gap and qualification
limits. These fixtures do not grant initialization, authorization, independent
root 32 operations or whole router-path admission.

See [the focused document](../../../docs/tops-lpinfo-candidate.md) for operation,
omission, replay and qualification boundaries. Fresh preparation and failed
attempts are preserved separately under `out/tops-lpinfo-candidate-20260929/`.
Final `source-02` reproduced both JSON files byte-for-byte. The `replay-01`
report covers all 1,024 saved blocks in `[123561000,123562024)`, five initialized
observed holders and one cleanup; it observes no append or equal metadata store.
Cold canonical observations remain uninitialized.
